Highlights

What our work looks like

A snapshot of the programs, partnerships, and community moments that define SJCDC.

Education
Tutoring & literacy

Children and adults supported with reading, math help, and computer-skills training year-round.

Health
Wellness workshops

Diabetes, heart-disease, nutrition, and mental-health education brought directly to the community.

Community
Meals & food drives

Free community meals and food distribution in partnership with Horton's Kids and the Capital Area Food Bank.

Partnerships
1LOVE 1HEART 1COMMUNITY

The 2024 'God Speaks' community day with #FAN and St. John CME Church — faith, fun, music, and family.

Giving
Holiday assistance

Gift cards and direct support delivered to deserving families at community events and during the holidays.

Youth
Garden & enrichment

Hands-on learning, summer programs, and mentorship that build confidence in Ward 8's young people.

Featured event

1LOVE 1HEART 1COMMUNITY

In April 2024, SJCDC joined #FAN and St. John CME Church for the inaugural "God Speaks" — a day of faith, fun, and family in Anacostia. The event brought neighbors together for live music, a gift-card giveaway, free kids' activities, and a community panel.

It's a vivid example of how SJCDC turns partnership into celebration — and celebration into connection.
